reviews.comment: This class was very informative and opened my eyes to a lot of things in our culture and history. Dr. Bare himself is a fantastic lecturer. I was impressed with how much he knew and how little bias he showed, even when teaching about many religions and topics through many perspectives. He is very genuine, knowledgable, and fun to engage with.

Take RELS 202! I truly think this class made me a better person and you can really tell how passionate professor Bare is. Class is lecture heavy and he doesn't post slides so attendance is basically mandatory but as long as you take notes exams aren't bad. Lots of reading but he is clear on what will be tested and I honestly skipped most of it.

Dr. Bare is a fantastic professor. I took this class to fulfill a CCR, but I was blown away. The lectures were super interesting and Dr. Bare is a true genius who knows a lot about this field. If you take good notes and show up to class, you will do just fine. Truly an amazing professor who is passionate about what he teaches. Amazing.

Such an amazing professor!!!! This is my last semester and I am so sad I didn't take Dr. Bare's class earlier bc I want to take more of his classes! He goes pretty fast in lecture but I loved it bc it kept me super engaged!

Dr. Bare is sooooo incredibly intelligent, and the way he structures his lectures and his overall class invites you to discover why it is so important to understand the history of Christianity from the Reformation on. I learned so much from his lectures (though at times they can feel partly overwhelming) and would recommend this class to anyone.

Knows it's CD required, so he's chill. Lectures are fast so type quickly (go to class). Exams were online and not too bad, you can get away with minimal studying. I didnt read the textbooks at all or go to a single office hours. Also has two short papers that he grades a little tough, weekly participation packback, and ungraded class discussions.

I have loved Dr. Bare's class. By far one of my favorite courses I have taken throughout my college career. He is passionate and engaging in the way he teaches, which makes for great lectures. There are 3 exams which not too difficult as long as you take good notes and study and two papers that are graded a little harshly imo but are not too bad.

LOVED Dr. Bare. He is so engaging and well-spoken, and his lectures are extremely interesting!! Exams are just based on lectures, so just take good notes during class and you will be fine! You also have two essays, and weekly Packback posts (discussions). He loves to hear your thoughts during class, and is so friendly and respecting of everyone.

Dr Bare is by far my favorite professor I had all semester. I took this class for my CD credit and did not regret it. I will say the class is graded by very few things making the tests (3 of them) weigh very heavy on our grade. If you review material they are easy though. You read a lot in this class and the tests ask reading questions as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loved Dr. Bare, super engaging lectures and interesting material, the kind of class that makes you think. Tests are based off of lectures so make sure to take notes (he does lecture outlines but no powerpoints). Two paper, graded kind of hard but he's always available to talk to and gives great feedback. Would 100% take him again for another course
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is hard but very interesting. Dr. Bare is the best prof at tamu, no questions asked. This class is test heavy and has a big project at the end but other than that: show up, study, do your work and you will pass. This class is so interesting and so awesome. Dr. Bare not only cares about how you do in class but also about your well being!

No attendance. His lecture is basically the test so be ready to take notes. The subject was fun to talk about because everyone has a different religious views in the class. I would highly recommend going to meet him as well. His tests contain MC and short answer, and 2 papers which are graded the hardest so start early so you can meet with him.

Dr. Bare is easily the best professor I've ever had. His lectures are amazing and you will learn a ton. I don't find myself dozing off like I will in other classes. He does not load you down with tons of work. His lectures are the most important thing for passing. If you go to class, and take notes, this will be an easy pass.

Easily the best prof I've had at A&M. His lectures are incredibly interesting, and he does a great job of hiding any personal beliefs. He's very accessible during office hours or by email. The project at the end gave the opportunity for creative liberty, and I had a lot of fun in it. Definitely would take him again!!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was very easy, and the information tested came straight from the lectures. I found the information interesting, and it is obvious Dr. Bare is very passionate about the topics and enjoys class discussions.

Absolutely loved taking Hist 222 Dr. Bare, it was actually my favorite class I have taken at A&M! However, it is not an easy A. He is a very particular grader and expects the best out of his students. He is very happy to meet with you outside of class and obviously loves what he teaches. GO TO EVERY CLASS AND DO THE READINGS IF YOU WANT AN A!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although with covid and classes being online, I really liked having Dr. Bare for this course. He is super passionate and teaches in such a great way. I will say it's test heavy, but honestly just take good notes during lecture and you should be fine! I was so close to an A and ended with a B, but it's all good just study hard!

Dr. Bare is an incredible lecturer. The class is very interesting and not too hard. It's 3 tests and a video research project which isn't bad once you get started. I loved it and highly recommend taking it. Just take decent notes and study a bit and you'll be fine for the tests.

Dr. Bare is a great professor. You can tell that he loves what he does and is very passionate about it. Just make sure you show up, pay attention, and show that you care about your grades and you should do fine. His exams are hard but nothing you can't figure out and pass if you study hard.

As long as you show up and take notes you'll be good. Wrote 4 papers and had 3 DQ. He's very nice and always willing to clarify anything misunderstood. He emphasizes what's necessary for the test, very lecture heavy that's about all it is . He is not a tough grader, he loves to get to know all his students

Had him last semester, Spring 2018, for Texas History and I enjoyed every minute of it! A really great professor who knows his stuff and cares for his student's success. Only 3 books to read outside of class which are very enticing and not at all dry. If I had credit hours remaining, I would take him again in a heartbeat!

Very good professor, explained things very clearly. You don't have to read a book for the course, but you do need to read 3 books for the exams. I would recommend reading them, as they account for almost half of all tests and there is little information about them online. Other than that, very easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: straightforward lecturer. he posts outlines online you can base your notes off of. his tests come straight from the lecture and 1 of the 3 books he has you read. attendance isnt mandatory but there are pop writing assignments which go over what was discussed in class the previous lecture (theyre very easy). hes a great prof and really nice person!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Bare is super nice, and a REALLY good lecturer. This helps a lot because the tests are mostly lecture-based but with a book for each unit. He is incredibly understanding and will answer any questions to the best of his ability. If he can't answer it, he will research it and get back to you during the next class.

AMAZING professor! His lectures are super interesting and he really does make an effort to be engaging in class. Make sure to read the books because tests are 30 lecture questions and 20 book questions. He is very easy to talk to and his office hours are extremely helpful! My favorite professor by far, I would definitely take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There is no textbook, however there are three books for reading for Texas History. His lectures are very thorough and informative. He gives about 10 pop quiz writing assignments in an effort to ensure attendance, so go to class because he has a decent poker face when asked when they might be.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: 3 multiple choice & true/false tests. there's no textbook but there's a book for each test he makes you read and takes 20 questions from the book so you kinda have to read it. there's also pop writing assignments over the previous lecture but they're not that bad. super approachable and willing to help. i would take him again
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He has really interesting lectures which are what the majority of his tests are based on. He makes you read 3 books, which I didn't, but thats about it. theres attendance pop quizzes but overall a pretty good class. I would take him. Loved him.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Super awesome teacher, only have 4 tests throughout the semester and all of them are based off the lectures. He gives great lectures and includes outlines, super easy to follow and find out what the major points are. He curves test to reach a good average and the tests are straight from the lecture outlines. 3 easy to read books with easy test ?'s

Great teacher, no textbook just 3 books to read. Lecture part of the test is fairly simple while some of the book questions can be difficult. However hes a very fair teacher and will curve if he sees that most people struggled. He does 5 random in class assignments which are easy. He makes the material interesting, and is a very nice guy

No textbook but there are books he wants you to read for 3 exams. Tests arent too bad, just follow the lecture outlines and read some of the books. You can tell hes really into the topic he teaches. You do have in class discussions but they are pretty easy and a completion grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He does not use a Textbook but instead assigns books to read before the 3 tests. Tests are not super hard. I did not read the books but I am a good test taker. Tests are multiple choice and he gives lecture outlines.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY
